guidance: Assign a reference for this profile; this is a blank brief rather than an account record.
Assign a version when the rules are agreed; preserve changes instead of overwriting the only brief.
State whether choices remain unresolved or the brief is approved internally; do not imply delivery approval.
Record the accountable internal role rather than a personal contact.
Describe the products or services that motivate the research without asserting suitability for an account.
State the company-level question this research should answer; do not enter a revenue or ROI promise.
Specify the intended operator or OEM or integrator or contractor or distributor role; no role is preselected.
Describe the positive activity evidence needed to include an account.
Specify who the activity serves if that distinction matters to this brief.
Give any additional route its own inclusion rule; separate incompatible profiles into another worksheet.
Write the activity question to investigate rather than asserting engineering compatibility.
List specifications or duty conditions that remain outside this account-fit decision.
Keep component selection and purchasing authority unresolved unless separately evidenced.
Name the exact geography; specify whether Ireland means the Republic or the island if applicable.
State whether the activity must occur in the territory or supplying it is sufficient.
Specify whether headquarters location matters; do not infer an operating site from an office address.
Choose company or facility explicitly; leave unagreed choices unresolved rather than using a default.
Define the evidence needed to attribute each relevant site to the company being counted.
Define treatment of subsidiaries and trading names; do not merge accounts on shared branding alone.
Describe how multiple references or sites under one company affect counts for the chosen unit.
State positively evidenced activities that fail this profile; missing information belongs on hold.
Specify which supported location facts fail the territory rule; absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
Separate preferences from must-haves; do not use them to override a failed mandatory check.
Enter only a justified requirement and its evidence standard; there is no default threshold.
Define whether existing-account exclusions apply to company or site or whole group.
Define agreed protected accounts or routes or territories; do not assume all resellers are excluded.
Point to the permitted internal company-level exclusion reference; do not paste confidential account lists here.
Record the actual exclusion-instruction version or date; blank does not mean there are no exclusions.
State which internal role can resolve ambiguous account or group matches.
Define what will connect the company to the required activity and operating site.
Define the observations needed to support the customer role and activity; do not fill with unverified facts.
Specify how the relevant operation and its location must be evidenced.
Require source references and actual review dates; unknown publication dates must remain unknown.
Define intended research and customer-output uses before retaining or sharing source content.
Specify applicable source and item-use checks separately from fit; no permissions are granted by this worksheet.
State how unresolved source-use rights block reuse or output; do not substitute a public URL for permission.
Define when missing or conflicting identity or fit evidence requires hold and the next verification question.
Require all mandatory identity and fit and source-use and exclusion checks to be satisfied; role match alone is insufficient.
Explicitly agree whether project research is required; distinguish not assessed from no qualifying signal found.
Enter a requested scope with its company or site unit; this is not an available or guaranteed account count.
Agree stopping conditions and treatment of coverage gaps; never weaken the brief to fill a quota.
Specify the fields needed for company-level output; named-person research is not included by this worksheet.
Define a separate hold output and next questions; exclude holds from accepted counts.
Record only terms actually agreed for this scope; do not assume a turnaround or replacement window.
Record who may approve changed rules and how the revised brief version will be retained.
List unresolved choices and their next decision; a completed worksheet does not grant outreach permission or legal clearance.
